an7.49:2.1: asubhasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti
an7.49:2.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an7.49:2.3: asubhasaññā paricitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:2.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nahārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati,
an7.49:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asubhasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:3.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno asubhasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ anusandati appaṭikūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:3.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ‘abhāvitā me asubhasaññā’ natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti
an7.49:3.4: sace pana bhikkhave bhikkhuno asubhasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato methunadhammasamāpattiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:3.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā bhāvitā me asubhasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti
an7.49:3.7: asubhasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti
an7.49:3.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭiccavuttaṃ. (2) maraṇasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an7.49:4.2: bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:4.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nahārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati.
an7.49:4.4: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno maraṇasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:5.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno maraṇasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ anusandati, appaṭikūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:5.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ‘abhāvitā me maraṇasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti’
an7.49:5.4: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno maraṇasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato jīvitanikantiyā cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:5.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ‘bhāvitā me maraṇasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti’
an7.49:5.7: maraṇasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti,
an7.49:5.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. (3)
an7.49:6.1: āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an7.49:6.2: āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā paricitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati …pe… upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:6.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nahārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati,
an7.49:6.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno āhāre paṭikkūlasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati …pe… upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:7.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno āhāre paṭikkūlasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ anusandati, appaṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:7.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ‘abhāvitā me āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti’
an7.49:7.4: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno āhāre paṭikkūlasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato rasataṇhāya cittaṃ patilīyati …pe… upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:7.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā ‘bhāvitā me āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti’
an7.49:7.7: āhāre paṭikkūlasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti,
an7.49:7.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. (4)
an7.49:8.1: sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an7.49:8.3: sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā paricitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacittesu cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:8.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nahāru daddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati. pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati,
an7.49:8.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacittesu cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:9.1: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacittesu cittaṃ anusandati, appaṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:9.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā “abhāvitā me sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti”
an7.49:9.4: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacittesu cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:9.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā “bhāvitā me sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, atthi me pubbonāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanā phalanti”
an7.49:9.7: sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti,
an7.49:9.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. (5)
an7.49:10.1: aniccasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an7.49:10.3: aniccasaññāparicitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lābhasakkārasiloke cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:10.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭapattaṃ vā nahārudaddulaṃ vā aggimhi pakkhittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati,
an7.49:10.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno aniccasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lābhasakkārasiloke cittaṃ patilīyati, patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati. upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti.
an7.49:11.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno aniccasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lābhasakkārasiloke cittaṃ anusandati, appaṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:11.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā abhāvitā me aniccasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanā phalanti
an7.49:11.4: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno aniccasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lābhasakkārasiloke cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativaṭṭati na sampasārīyati, upekkhā vā paṭikkūlyatā vā saṇṭhāti,
an7.49:11.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā bhāvitā me aniccasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanā phalanti,
an7.49:11.7: aniccasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti,
an7.49:11.8: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. (6)
an7.49:12.1: anicce dukkhasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an7.49:12.3: anicce dukkhasaññāparicitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhanāya tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake.
an7.49:13.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno anicce dukkhasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhanāya tibbā bhayasaññā na paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake,
an7.49:13.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā abhāvitā me anicce dukkhasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanā phalanti,
an7.49:13.4: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno anicce dukkhasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato ālasye kosajje vissaṭṭhiye pamāde ananuyoge apaccavekkhanāya tibbā bhayasaññā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, seyyathāpi ukkhittāsike vadhake,
an7.49:13.5: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā subhāvitā me anicce dukkhasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti
an7.49:13.7: anicce dukkhasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti
an7.49:13.8: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ. (7)
an7.49:14.1: dukkhe anattasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti, iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an7.49:14.3: dukkhe anattasaññā paricitena bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṃkāramamiṃkāramānāpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhā samatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ.
an7.49:15.1: sace bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dukkhe anattasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṃkāramamiṃkāramānāpagataṃ mānasaṃ na hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ,
an7.49:15.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā abhāvitā me dukkhe anattasaññā, natthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti.
an7.49:16.1: sace pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dukkhe anattasaññā paricitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṃkāramamiṃkāramānāpagataṃ mānasaṃ hoti vidhāsamatikkantaṃ santaṃ suvimuttaṃ,
an7.49:16.2: veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhunā subhāvitā me dukkhe anattasaññā, atthi me pubbenāparaṃ viseso, pattaṃ me bhāvanāphalanti.
an7.49:16.4: dukkhe anattasaññā bhikkhave, bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti,
an7.49:16.5: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an7.49:17.1: imā kho bhikkhave satta saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mahānisaṃsā amatogadhā amatapariyosānāti.
